promptZh: 中国书法是中国传统文化的重要组成部分。书法家使用毛笔和墨书写汉字，通过线条的变化表现美感和情感。今天，许多学校仍开设书法课程，帮助年轻一代了解汉字的历史并传承这一古老艺术。
referenceAnswer: Chinese calligraphy is an important part of traditional Chinese culture. Calligraphers use brushes and ink to write Chinese characters and express beauty and emotion through changing lines. Today, many schools still offer calligraphy courses to help the younger generation understand the history of Chinese characters and pass on this ancient art.

promptZh: 剪纸是一种流行的中国民间艺术，通常用红纸制作。人们把花鸟、动物和吉祥文字剪成各种图案，在春节等节日贴在窗户上。红色象征幸福和好运，精美的剪纸也展现了普通人的创造力。
referenceAnswer: Paper cutting is a popular Chinese folk art usually made with red paper. People cut flowers, birds, animals and lucky characters into different designs and put them on windows during festivals such as the Spring Festival. Red represents happiness and good luck, while fine paper cuts also show the creativity of ordinary people.

promptZh: 中国种茶和饮茶的历史十分悠久。茶不仅是一种日常饮品，也是中国文化的重要组成部分。主人常用茶欢迎客人，人们也在饮茶时与家人朋友交流。随着国际交流的发展，中国茶在世界各地越来越受欢迎。
referenceAnswer: China has a long history of growing and drinking tea. Tea is not only a daily drink but also an important part of Chinese culture. Hosts often serve tea to welcome guests, and people communicate with family and friends while drinking it. With the development of international exchange, Chinese tea has become increasingly popular around the world.

promptZh: 二十四节气是古代中国人观察自然变化形成的时间体系。它帮助农民安排生产，也提醒人们顺应季节调整生活。如今，节气知识仍通过食物、习俗和公共活动传播，成为连接现代生活与传统文化的重要桥梁。
referenceAnswer: The twenty-four solar terms are a time system developed by ancient Chinese people through observing changes in nature. They helped farmers arrange production and reminded people to adjust their lives to the seasons. Today, knowledge of the solar terms is still spread through food, customs and public activities, serving as an important bridge between modern life and traditional culture.

promptZh: 中国传统园林重视建筑与自然的和谐。设计者利用山石、水面、花木和曲折的小路，在有限空间中创造丰富景色。游人移动时会看到不断变化的画面，这种设计反映了中国人亲近自然的生活观念。
referenceAnswer: Traditional Chinese gardens value harmony between buildings and nature. Designers use rocks, water, plants and winding paths to create rich scenery in limited space. Visitors see changing views as they move, and this design represents the Chinese idea of living close to nature.

promptZh: 京剧是中国最具代表性的传统戏曲之一。演员通过唱、念、做、打讲述历史故事，不同颜色的脸谱代表人物的性格。近年来，许多年轻艺术家尝试使用现代舞台技术，使这一古老艺术更容易被国内外观众理解。
referenceAnswer: Peking Opera is one of the most representative forms of traditional Chinese opera. Performers tell stories from history through singing, speech, acting and movement, while different facial colors represent characters' personalities. In recent years, many young artists have used modern stage technology to make this ancient art easier for audiences at home and abroad to understand.

promptZh: 古代丝绸之路连接中国与世界其他地区。商人运送丝绸、茶叶等商品，也传播语言、知识和艺术。长期交流促进了不同社会之间的理解。今天，丝绸之路仍被视为文化交流与共同发展的重要象征。
referenceAnswer: The ancient Silk Road connected China with other parts of the world. Traders carried silk, tea and other goods, while also spreading languages, knowledge and art. Long-term exchange improved understanding and helped different societies develop together. Today, the Silk Road is still regarded as an important symbol of cultural exchange.

promptZh: 端午节是中国重要的传统节日之一。许多家庭包粽子、观看龙舟比赛，以纪念古代诗人屈原。不同地区形成了各具特色的庆祝方式，但表达的共同愿望是珍惜家国情感并祝愿人们健康平安。
referenceAnswer: The Dragon Boat Festival is one of China's important traditional festivals. Many families make zongzi and watch dragon boat races in memory of the ancient poet Qu Yuan. Different regions have developed their own ways of celebration, but they share the wish to value love for family and country and to hope for health and safety.

promptZh: 中国瓷器以精美的造型和图案闻名。古代工匠不断改进烧制技术，使瓷器既实用又美观。瓷器通过海上贸易传到许多国家，对当地生活和艺术产生影响，也成为中国文化走向世界的重要代表。
referenceAnswer: Chinese porcelain is famous for its fine shapes and designs. Ancient craftsmen continuously improved firing skills, making porcelain both useful and beautiful. It reached many countries through maritime trade, influenced local life and art, and came to represent Chinese culture around the world.

promptZh: 中国古代水利工程体现了人们利用自然、服务社会的智慧。以都江堰为例，它通过巧妙设计调节水量，既减少洪水，也为农田提供水源。两千多年后，这项工程仍在发挥作用，并受到良好保护。
referenceAnswer: Ancient Chinese water projects show the wisdom of using nature to serve society. Dujiangyan, for example, controls water through an ingenious design, reducing floods and providing water for farmland. More than two thousand years later, the project is still in use and is well protected.

promptZh: 春节是中国家庭团聚的重要时刻。无论工作地点离家多远，许多人都会设法回乡，与亲人吃团圆饭。如今，视频通话和网络红包改变了部分庆祝方式，但家人彼此祝福、共同迎接新年的传统没有改变。
referenceAnswer: The Spring Festival is an important time for Chinese family reunions. No matter how far they work from home, many people try to return and have a reunion dinner with relatives. In modern life, video calls and online red packets have changed some celebrations, but this important part of family culture remains.

promptZh: 中国功夫有着悠久历史，最初与自卫、劳动和军事训练有关。经过长期发展，它逐渐形成多种流派。练习功夫不仅能够增强体质，还强调耐心、自律和尊重，因此在许多国家受到欢迎。
referenceAnswer: Chinese kung fu has a long history and was originally used to protect people during work and military training. As it continued to develop, it gradually formed many styles. Practicing kung fu can improve physical health and also emphasizes patience, self-discipline and respect, so it is popular in many countries.

promptZh: 中国结由一根绳编成，结构对称，颜色通常鲜艳。它既可用于装饰，也常被当作礼物赠送。不同形状表达团结、幸福和长寿等愿望。今天，设计者把传统方法与现代材料结合，使中国结进入更多日常生活场景。
referenceAnswer: A Chinese knot is made from a single cord, with a balanced structure and usually bright colors. It is used as decoration and is often given as a gift. Different shapes represent wishes for unity, happiness and long life. Today, people design new knots by combining traditional methods with modern materials, bringing this part of Chinese culture into more daily settings.

promptZh: 汉字记录了中国数千年的历史，也保存着丰富的文化信息。许多汉字由表示意义的部分组成，人们可以从字形理解古人的生活。随着科技发展，汉字输入更加方便，但规范书写和准确使用仍然十分重要。
referenceAnswer: Chinese characters record thousands of years of history and preserve rich information about Chinese culture. Many characters contain parts that show meaning, allowing people to understand ancient life through their forms. As technology develops, input becomes easier, but standard writing and accurate use remain very important.

promptZh: 传统中医重视预防疾病，并强调身体与自然环境之间的平衡。人们常根据季节调整饮食、运动和休息。虽然现代生活节奏加快，规律作息和适度锻炼等观念仍对维护公众健康具有积极意义。
referenceAnswer: Traditional Chinese medicine values disease prevention and emphasizes balance between the body and nature. People often adjust food, exercise and rest according to the seasons. Although modern life is faster, regular routines and proper exercise remain meaningful for protecting public health.

promptZh: 长城是中国古代重要的防御工程，也是世界闻名的文化遗产。它穿过高山和荒漠，反映了古代劳动者的智慧。如今，政府和当地社区共同保护长城，并提醒游客文明参观，不要损坏古老建筑。
referenceAnswer: The Great Wall was an important defense project in ancient China and is also a world-famous cultural heritage site. It crosses mountains and deserts and reflects the wisdom of ancient workers. Today, the government and local communities protect it together and remind visitors not to damage the old structure.

promptZh: 中国许多传统村落保存着古老住宅、街道和生活习俗。它们不仅记录地方历史，也展示人与自然长期相处的方式。保护村落需要当地居民参与，同时应合理发展旅游，避免传统生活被过度商业化。
referenceAnswer: Many traditional villages in China preserve old houses, streets and customs. They record local history and show how people have lived with nature over time. Protecting these villages requires local community participation, while tourism should be developed properly to avoid excessive commercialization of traditional life.

promptZh: 龙在中国文化中是一种重要象征，代表力量、智慧和好运。它出现在古代建筑、节日表演和许多艺术作品中。现代人仍通过舞龙等公共活动表达美好愿望，并向年轻一代介绍相关历史。
referenceAnswer: The dragon is an important symbol in Chinese culture, representing strength, wisdom and good luck. It appears in ancient buildings, festival performances and many works of art. Modern people still express good wishes through public activities such as dragon dances and introduce the related history to younger generations.

promptZh: 中国饮食文化重视分享。家人或朋友围坐一桌，从共同的菜肴中取食，这种方式有助于交流感情。不同地区使用各自的食材和烹饪方法，形成丰富多样的地方风味，也反映当地自然条件和历史。
referenceAnswer: Chinese food culture values sharing. Family members or friends sit around one table and take food from shared dishes, which helps communication. Different regions use their own ingredients and cooking methods, creating rich local flavors and reflecting local nature and history.

promptZh: 大熊猫是中国特有的珍稀动物，也是广受欢迎的文化形象。多年来，中国建立自然保护区，改善其生活环境，并与其他国家开展研究合作。大熊猫数量的恢复说明长期保护和国际合作能够产生积极成果。
referenceAnswer: The giant panda is a rare animal unique to China and a popular cultural image. For years, China has created nature reserves to protect pandas, improved their living environment and conducted research with other countries. The recovery of the panda population shows that long-term international cooperation can produce positive results.

promptZh: 造纸术是中国古代重要发明之一。纸张比早期书写材料更轻便，降低了记录和传播知识的成本。随着技术传向其他地区，书籍生产得到发展，更多普通人有机会学习，对世界文明产生了深远影响。
referenceAnswer: Papermaking was one of the important inventions of ancient China. Paper was lighter than earlier writing materials and reduced the cost of recording and spreading knowledge and written language. As the skill reached other regions, book production developed and more ordinary people gained opportunities to learn, deeply influencing world civilization.

promptZh: 中国民族音乐使用二胡、古筝、笛子等传统乐器，常以自然景色、历史故事和日常生活为主题。现代音乐家不断尝试新的表演方式，并与其他音乐风格合作，使更多年轻人和国际听众了解这种艺术。
referenceAnswer: Chinese folk music uses traditional instruments such as the erhu, guzheng and flute, often taking nature, stories from history and daily life as themes. Modern musicians keep trying new forms and work with other musical styles, enabling more young people and international audiences to understand this art.

promptZh: 农历九月初九是重阳节。登高、赏菊是传统习俗，而敬老已成为这一节日的重要主题。许多社区组织志愿者看望老人，帮助他们解决生活困难，并鼓励年轻人重视家庭责任和代际联系。
referenceAnswer: The ninth day of the ninth lunar month is the Double Ninth Festival. Climbing hills and enjoying chrysanthemums are traditional customs, while respect for older people has become an important theme. Many communities organize volunteers to visit older residents, help with daily difficulties and encourage young people to value family responsibility and ties between generations.

promptZh: 近年来，中国越来越多的博物馆利用数字技术展示文物。参观者可以通过互动屏幕了解历史，也能在线欣赏展览。这些现代方法扩大了公共文化服务，使传统知识更容易进入学校、社区和普通家庭。
referenceAnswer: In recent years, more Chinese museums have used digital technology to display cultural objects. Visitors can learn about history through interactive screens and enjoy exhibitions online. These modern methods have expanded public cultural services, making traditional knowledge more accessible to schools, communities and ordinary families.
